title: Consequence of not correcting a wrong ball mistake
question: What is the result if you finish a hole without correcting your mistake of playing the wrong ball?
explanation: If you fail to correct your mistake and finish the hole with a wrong ball, you are disqualified.
imagePrompt: A teen girl golfer on the green, holing out a different ball while other players look on, with a putter in hand and one ball near the hole under sunny weather.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer holes out a wrong ball on the green.

issues: The golf ball is correctly sized and singular.
The putter is realistic with a correct putter head, proper shaft and grip length.
Teen girl golfer has a natural, plausible golf stance and posture.
Golfer matches mixed ethnicity and dark skin tone, with blue top and red trousers.
The scene is clearly a sunny putting green with believable course features.
Other players are looking on in the distance per the prompt.
